case: The same six pairs, branches written in reverse order, regenerated the same way.
why: The review's benign twin verbatim -- `the six branches in a different order, which must pass`. A disjunction is a set and its branch order changes nothing it admits; a check that refuses a reordering is comparing serialisation rather than meaning, which is the defect the adverse half of this pair is about. Lane `r8-contracts-f` recorded this twin as NOT EXPRESSIBLE because the patch applier writes JSON only. That is true of `patch` and false of `tools_patch`, which ships a hunk of the derivation and regenerates -- the same mechanism the adverse half needs, so the nearer substitute it proposed is not required.
